Job Description Summary

The vision of the SVO – New Products team is to create robust but cost-effective wind turbine product designs by providing best-in-class system value optimization, load assessment, validation, methods and tools.

As an SVO engineer, you will perform system value optimization work, deliver loads and co-simulations, prepare certification documentation, support methods and standard-work development, and develop the loads toolchain.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Perform system value optimization, tradeoffs in loads, stability, operation and performance, feasibility studies and tech charts.
  • Prepare load inputs and simulation models; execute simulations, post-process results and update load envelopes.
  • Perform operability and frequency-domain stability checks; hand off model and controller parameters.
  • Prepare certification load packages and answer questions from certification bodies.
  • Prepare co-simulations for prototype and fleet-leader validation and resolve simulation/field-measurement gaps.
  • Advance load methods and standard work and improve pre- and post-processing toolchains.
  • Prepare design reviews and technical underwriting documents, assess risks and mitigations, update loads DFMEA, and support lean initiatives.

Qualifications / Requirements

  • B.S. in Mechanical, Wind, Systems or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or equivalent.

Desired Characteristics

  • Technical awareness of preparing loads for wind turbines.
  • Complex problem-solving and software-development skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication and ability to defend a technical position.
  • Master’s degree in Mechanical, Wind, Systems or Aerospace Engineering.
  • GE Renewable Energy Edison Engineer and relevant corporate training.

Relocation assistance provided: No.
